stem.en: During the electrolysis of water, what happens at the cathode?
stem.et: Mis toimub vee elektrolüüsi ajal katoodil?

label.en: Reduction occurs: hydrogen cations gain electrons from the electrode and are reduced to hydrogen gas
label.et: Toimub redutseerumine: vesinikkatioonid saavad elektroodilt elektrone ja redutseeruvad vesinikgaasiks

label.en: Oxidation occurs: hydrogen atoms lose electrons to the electrode
label.et: Toimub oksüdeerumine: vesinikuaatomid loovutavad elektroode elektroone

label.en: Nothing happens at the cathode; all reaction occurs only at the anode
label.et: Katoodil ei toimu midagi; kogu reaktsioon toimub ainult anoodil

label.en: The electrode itself dissolves into solution at the cathode
